condition: When the host is in a timezone with a +00:00 offset (e.g. Europe/London in winter, Lisbon), the utc plugin's valueOf treats a $localOffset of 0 as missing because it uses `||`, so dayjs.tz(string, zone) and utcOffset() can come out one hour off.
workaround: Run the process with TZ=UTC, or patch the utc plugin's valueOf to use a null/undefined check (??) on $localOffset instead of ||, as in PR #1678.
